text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًۭا

baseline.text: O, Sen benimle birlikteyken sabretmeye güç yetiremezsin demedim mi, dedi.

findings.text: İlk itirazdan sonra önceki sözün tekrarı, öngörüyü kanıta ve öğretmenle kalma kapasitesini öğrencinin kendi tepkisini görmesini sağlayan geri bildirime dönüştürür.

activation_trace.role: Capacity and enablement provide the modal limit, making the prediction about what can be sustained in practice.
Holding the self back from distress supplies the required action whose sustained performance is denied.

changed_reading.after: You will not be able, while accompanying me, to keep reactive judgment held back.
changed_reading.before: You will not be able to wait calmly with me.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "lan tastati'a ma'iya sabran" joins denied capacity to patience in companionship.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ability is not treated as a free-standing faculty: it is the ability to keep the self from reactive distress while remaining with the speaker.

activation_trace.role: Audibly produced speech grounds the reminder as an overt return to words already placed between the companions.
Speech used in negotiating an affair lets the recalled saying function as a term governing continued companionship.

changed_reading.after: The speaker reactivates a previously stated term and asks the hearer to recognize that the encounter has instantiated it.
changed_reading.before: The speaker rebukes the hearer by repeating a prediction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus line frames its claim with two occurrences of q-w-l: "he said" and "did I not say."
baseline_models.mechanism: The doubled speech root makes the line a speech act that retrieves an earlier term and places the hearer back under it, rather than merely supplying new information.

activation_trace.role: Sides and boundaries supply a spatial image for containing judgment during the shared passage.
Practical ability determines whether that boundary can actually be maintained.

changed_reading.after: Patience is a maintained boundary around judgment and intervention.
changed_reading.before: Patience is an amount of waiting.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object "sabran" is what the hearer cannot sustain "with me."
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch image of sides or bounds recasts patience as an enclosure that keeps an immediate reaction from spilling into intervention.

activation_trace.role: The focus utterance overtly recalls another utterance.
The earlier produced saying supplies the exact speech event now being recalled.
The earlier denial of practical capacity supplies the prediction whose accuracy the focus tests.
Earlier self-restraint names the same demanded performance that has now failed once.

changed_reading.after: The focus points to the first event as evidence that an already announced limit has manifested.
changed_reading.before: The focus makes a fresh judgment about the hearer's patience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier line already joins saying, inability, companionship, and patience; the focus adds the interrogative recall, converting prediction into demonstrated recurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-verbatim recurrence; I infer that the focus marks a prediction becoming an observed result, while a live alternative is simple emphatic repetition.
structural_cues: 18:72 repeats the core wording of 18:67 and inserts "did I not say."

activation_trace.role: Practical capacity remains the focus predicate being diagnosed.
Self-restraint is the focus action whose epistemic condition is exposed.
Complete encompassing in knowledge supplies the missing scope that would make restraint intelligible.
Knowledge of an affair's interior distinguishes hidden explanation from immediately visible action.

changed_reading.after: The hearer cannot maintain restraint across the gap between visible action and unavailable interior knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inability to be patient is specified as failure to encompass the inner information of an event; patience becomes a bridge across an interval of incomplete knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-encompassment and interior knowledge; I infer a causal arrow from missing interior information to unstable restraint, while temperament remains a possible secondary factor.
structural_cues: The explanatory question in 18:68 directly follows the first prediction in 18:67.

activation_trace.role: Negotiated speech lets the reminder reactivate the agreed procedure.
Questioning as a request names the intervention that the agreement postpones.
A newly arising report supplies the guide-controlled point at which explanation may begin.
Bringing something back to awareness makes disclosure the endpoint of the required delay.

changed_reading.after: The rebuke marks a breach of an agreed order in which moral questions are delayed until the guide opens explanation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The companionship has an explicit sequencing rule: inquiry is withheld until the guide initiates a renewed account. The focus reminder therefore enforces timing, not silence without end.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prohibition, a temporal boundary, and guide-initiated mention; I infer that patience means observing this disclosure protocol, not abandoning moral perception.
structural_cues: 18:70 places "until" between the prohibition on asking and the guide's own initiation of mention.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint anchors the need to suspend intervention without erasing alarm.
The concrete hole supplies the immediately visible damage from which the hearer reasons.
Drowning supplies the feared endpoint that turns observation into urgent accusation.

changed_reading.after: The hearer cannot suspend a morally urgent causal verdict when visible damage appears to entail collective death.
changed_reading.before: The hearer is simply impatient with an unexplained act.

context_deltas.mechanism: A visible breach is immediately projected into drowning. The focus names the incapacity to keep that surface-to-catastrophe inference from becoming an interrupting accusation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies damage and a stated catastrophic purpose; I infer that the hearer collapses possible consequence into intended outcome, while genuine rescue concern remains a live alternative motive.
structural_cues: The question in 18:71 grammatically links making the hole to drowning the vessel's people.

activation_trace.role: The focus names failed self-restraint, which the next line redescribes from the hearer's side.
Loss of an item from active recollection supplies a cognitive account of the breach.
Imposing what weighs heavily turns strict consequence into a burden the hearer asks to limit.
Difficulty and severity name the feared result of treating the first lapse as terminal.

changed_reading.after: The focus records a real failure that is immediately negotiated as forgetful lapse rather than yet treated as final disqualification.
changed_reading.before: The focus conclusively exposes a fixed incapacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The response recodes the failure as lost recollection and asks that accountability not become an overpowering load; the reminder operates inside a negotiated allowance for human cognitive lapse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgetting, oppressive burden, and hardship; I infer a plea for proportional enforcement, while "forgetting" could also function as an excuse rather than a complete causal diagnosis.
structural_cues: 18:73 answers the focus reminder with two coordinated negative requests.

activation_trace.role: The focus reminder is an intermediate speech event on the way to eventual disclosure.
Separation distinguishes the end of companionship from the beginning of retrospective explanation.
A delivered report supplies the deferred disclosure promised by the earlier protocol.
Return to outcome or consequence directs attention from the act's first appearance to what it comes to mean.
The repeated capacity term identifies the same limit named in the focus.
Repeated restraint binds the final diagnosis directly back to the focus claim.

changed_reading.after: The focus foreshadows that the capacity test and the companionship will end before the hidden outcome can be narrated.
changed_reading.before: The focus is only a local correction after the first interruption.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later recurrence links inability and patience to a report of outcomes, but that report begins only at separation. The focus thus anticipates a temporal structure in which explanation arrives after the companionship condition has failed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation followed by reported outcome; I infer that full explanation is structurally delayed until after the trial, while "interpretation" may denote an explanatory account rather than temporal maturation alone.
structural_cues: 18:78 couples separation, promised interpretation, and a recurrence of the inability-to-patience formula.

activation_trace.role: Patience as maintained bounds anchors the demand to keep judgment within the visible scene's limits.
What is placed beyond visibility supplies the missing threat outside the hearer's initial frame.
Sovereign power supplies the agent able to convert an intact vessel into a total loss.
Forcible unjust seizure supplies the hidden causal pressure that reverses the apparent value of damage.

changed_reading.after: Patience means withholding a total verdict while a bounded loss may be protecting the vulnerable from an unseen total confiscation.
changed_reading.before: Patience means tolerating an act that appears pointlessly destructive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The damaged vessel is later placed against a concealed coercive power that seizes intact vessels. Bearing a local defect becomes the means by which the vulnerable retain the whole.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden power and forcible seizure; I infer that temporary impairment preserves ownership, while this reversal may be specific to the vessel rather than a universal rule about harmful appearances.
structural_cues: 18:79 retrospectively contrasts a deliberately introduced defect with seizure of every intact vessel.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint remains the focus demand now reread through delayed preservation.
Stored and protected wealth supplies a concrete value that must remain hidden until maturity.
Merciful tenderness names the governing quality of an intervention that initially appears unrewarded.
Return to outcome gathers the concealed purposes into the retrospective reading.
The final repeated capacity term closes the arc begun by the focus prediction.
The final repeated restraint term explicitly binds delayed outcome back to the focus.

changed_reading.after: The focus asks for disciplined non-interference across the period in which protected value remains hidden and unfinished.
changed_reading.before: The focus asks for passive delay before an explanation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The terminal explanation joins hidden stored value, mercy, outcome, and the final recurrence of inability and patience. Restraint is required because protective value may remain concealed until its proper time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden value, mercy, maturation, and the closing recurrence; I infer that restraint protects time-dependent goods from premature judgment, while not every unexplained act need contain such a good.
structural_cues: The pericope ends by repeating inability and patience after naming interpretation and concealed treasure.

remaining_uncertainties: The response's appeal to forgetting may be a full cognitive explanation, a conventional plea, or both.
The boundary and stopper readings are branch-driven analogies and should not displace the strong restraint sense.
The later reversals establish these events' hidden purposes but do not license a general rule that every apparent harm is secretly beneficial.
strongest_changes: The denied capacity is specifically the ability to restrain judgment while interior knowledge is unavailable.
The reminder enforces a timed disclosure agreement: questioning is delayed until the guide initiates explanation.
Later outcomes reverse the first visible valuation, turning local damage or unrewarded work into protection against larger loss.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is both a returned speech term and a hinge between visible breach and deferred outcome; its patience language becomes epistemic, procedural, and temporally protective without losing its anchor in self-restraint.

activation_trace.role: A stopper that seals an opening supplies an exploratory material image for restraint that prevents reaction from escaping.
The literal hole in the preceding event activates the stopper image without replacing the focus meaning.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, patience acts like a stopper: it holds the opening made by shock until the event can be contained by explanation.
changed_reading.before: Patience is only an inward quantity of endurance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from moral restraint into vessel-like material mechanics; it remains anchored in the focus root's stopper branch and the immediately preceding hole, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as the lexical sense of "sabran" here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus object "sabran" follows an episode organized around making a hole in a vessel.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Prediction becomes evidence through repetition.** `ق و ل` B001 (“uttered speech”) cites prior speech after the first breach; `ط و ع` B001 again locates failed capacity in companionship. Repetition after 18:67 changes the line from forecast to diagnosed pattern. I infer that the teacher’s reminder is a feedback device: it makes Moses observe his own response, not merely the damaged ship. The lesson’s object begins to include the learner.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:75’s intensified repetition showed the first reminder becoming a progressively personal diagnosis.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Capacity depends on compliance with the learning relation.** `ط و ع/B003` is practical capacity; `ط و ع/B001` is pliant obedience and willing yielding. The same inability predicted in 18:67 returns directly after the question violates 18:70, and 18:73 seeks relief rather than disputing the rule. I infer that `تَسْتَطِيعَ` is not a fixed shortage of temperament: the capacity exists only while the learner yields to the procedure that lets evidence mature. The repeated sentence reads as diagnosis of a relational capability.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:73–76 showed capacity being renegotiated through excuse and a final condition, confirming that it belongs to compliance with the relation.

words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) makes the whole ayah a reported speech event before the rebuke itself begins, not a narrative explanation of the ship breach. Its active perfect form keeps the speaker responsible but unnamed, so the response is compact and authoritative. The word also starts the recursion of the scene: present speech introduces a question about prior speech, placing this first rebuke within the repeated warning sequence at 18:67, 18:72, 18:75, and 18:78, before the later repetition adds a separate dative address.
